messages:
maria p: Heads up 11 need a slim case study + promo kit for the Uptick launch. Goal: short landing snippet, 1-minute customer video, social thread + webinar quote. Can we get approvals and routing set by next Friday?
leah content: On it. I'll assemble a single-sheet "publish kit" with copy variants (short, medium, long), 3 headline options, and suggested CTAs. Dropping a draft link in 30m: https://docs.google.com/uptick-kit (comments welcome).
sam p: Benchmarks to use: 1.8x throughput on burst reads, ~35% lower per-token cost after caching. I'll attach the runbook and the query used to compute numbers. Recommend saying "up to 35%" to be conservative.
elaine legal: Good call on conservative phrasing. Legal asks: (1) sign-off on direct quotes, (2) explicit permission for video clips, (3) we should avoid competitor comparisons. I'll prepare a one-click signature release they can sign in DocuSign. CC their PR lead.
ryan cs: I'll schedule two 15-min sessions with their product lead and eng lead. Prefer Zoom. Will request a short on-camera clip (45s) and three one-line quotes. Also will include a checkbox on the permission form: share clips for promotional use.
devin design: For the 1-min video: plan a 30s highlight reel + 30s quote. I'll make a branded lower-third and a quick intro slate. Deliverables: 1:1 horizontal MP4, 9:16 vertical cut, and an audio-only clip. Template will be in the doc.
nick sales: For lead routing: create HubSpot workflow that tags any demo request mentioning "Uptick" or selecting "Heard about Uptick" field. Route to the "uptick-launch" SDR queue. Also add property: "marketing_source = uptick_campaign".
ops-bot: Example HubSpot rule (draft):
```
if form_submission.includes("Uptick") {
  set contact.property.marketing_source = "uptick_campaign";
  add_to_queue("uptick-launch");
  set priority = "high";
}
```
maria p: @nick sales @ryan cs please confirm ops can implement that rule by Wed. Also @olivia pr needs to review the messaging before we publish.
olivia pr: I'll review the social blurbs and the press-friendly quote. Please include a "no embargo" or "embargo until" field on the release so we can coordinate. I'll ping their comms contact.
sam p: One more data note: the 1.8x was median under our benchmark harness with prefix caching. Ill paste the exact test command into the doc so legal/product can verify.
elaine legal: I'll add three redlines to the release: no raw revenue, types of allowed edits to quotes, and an explicit approval step for any changes to the customer's quote. Also include a clause for use of short clips in paid ads.
leah content: Draft checklist:
- build publish kit (leah)
- lock benchmark phrasing (sam + legal)
- get DocuSign release (elaine)
- schedule interviews + collect clips (ryan)
- produce video assets + images (devin)
- HubSpot routing + SDR script (nick)
- PR review + embargo flag (olivia)
- finalize social schedule (leah)

maria p: Timeline: Leah draft by Tue noon, Legal sign-off Wed EOD, Media assets Thurs, HubSpot routing + SDR script Fri morning, final go/no-go Fri 4pm. Everyone reply with thumbs if that works.
devin design: Thumbs. I'll need raw clips by Wed noon to hit Thursday production.
nick sales: Thumbs. Will draft SDR script with two openers: demo-first and content-first.
ryan cs: Thumbs. I'll push invites and include the permission link in meeting invites.
elaine legal: Thumbs. I'll post the DocuSign link and the redline summary in the doc.
leah content: Thumbs. I'll also draft three tweet threads and one LinkedIn longform post.
ops-bot: Reminder set: "Uptick publish kit due" on 2026-03-29 16:00.
maria p: Thanks team 12 ping me directly if the customer asks for changes to quotes. We'll iterate once legal has the signed release.
